title: Tool Differentia: Relational Static Analysis for AI Agent Tool Descriptions
description: Tool definitions are commonly validated one at a time, although an agent selects tools from a set of alternatives. This technical note defines tool differentia as the distinguishing information needed between neighboring tool definitions and describes H1.6, a deterministic, pre-runtime static analysis implemented in LintLang.
